findings: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-consistency-batches-run.py:503 non-blocking: the five controls are computed into a dict and recorded in the artifact but never gate the run — main() returns 0 at line 857 whatever they say, so a regression that pushed a batch past the cap or mixed a rename into a documentation batch would still exit 0 and leave a healthy-looking gate log; the file carries no assertion at all.

docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-consistency-batches-run.py:668 non-blocking: the chunks_within test repeats one condition twice (len(chunk) <= BATCH_CAP and len(chunk) <= BATCH_CAP), so the second conjunct checks nothing and whatever second bound it was meant to assert is missing.

docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-consistency-batches-run.py:129 non-blocking: _collapse re-implements the whitespace collapse that the census runner loaded at line 61 already owns at sib-consistency-census-run.py:102, a capability it could have reused from the module it already loads by path.

docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-consistency-batches-run.py:496 non-blocking: allowed_names includes set(row_by_id), every live name, so the no_invented_names control can never report a batch row drawn from a live name outside the census and therefore cannot detect the mutation it is named for.

docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-consistency-batches-run.py:829 non-blocking: the compact artifact strips the census proposed anchor definition text (and the definition variants) from proposals, so the landed JSON carries only definition_from and template_signature while the done_when asks each row to carry its current definition and the proposed anchor definition; the text is one lookup away in the committed census and in the run-directory expanded copy, so the sizing still reads, but the repository artifact alone does not.
notes: The reviewed run was not armed, so its manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite pair; added_failure_count is 0 because the run's only gate is the sizing script itself, which was rerun at the reviewed head and exited 0 with an identical summary. Findings are all non-blocking: the produced artifact is correct and reproducible, and the defects are in the strength of its self-checks and in two literal completeness points.
